sentences.en: Her skin is coarse from years of working outdoors.
sentences.zh: 她长期户外工作，皮肤变得粗糙了。

sentences.en: He was coarse in his habits and brutish in his ways.
sentences.zh: 他的生活习惯粗鲁野蛮。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, my Uighur is a little coarse.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我的维吾尔语有点生疏。

senses.zh: 粗糙的，粗糙不平的；粗俗的，粗鲁的；粗劣的，劣质的
